name: Kunisaki Yukito
source: A young traveler on a journey to find the meaning in a story his mother left him. A story about a girl who has been all alone in the skies for years. He is able to move puppets without actually touching them, using a magic called "Houjutsu". He lives with [url=/c9996]Haruko[/url] and [url=/c9995]Misuzu[/url] during his stay in their hometown. [spoiler]After finding out [url=/c9995]Misuzu[/url] is connected to the girl his mother was talking about, he fears that both him and her will perish together, just like in his mother's story. He initially chooses to leave [url=/c9995]Misuzu[/url] behind for her own safety, only to go back on his decision and promise her that he'll always be by her side. He later passes away, reincarnating as [url=/c63800]Sora[/url] during the Air arc.[/spoiler]
